title: Physical AI Platform: Sovereign Physical AI and Robotics Guidance Platform
description:
The Physical AI Platform at iteration 51: a static-first, componentised knowledge graph, engineering workbench, simulator, education system, research system, manufacturing system, teleoperation layer, safety system and compliance framework for physical AI and robotics. It runs as a static site with no mandatory backend, database, cloud AI provider or proprietary runtime.

The release carries the Master Requirements Document (docs/MRD.md), the predecessor documents it consolidates, the repository's conformance suites and acceptance script, thirteen drop-in engineering packages, and a provenance ledger (docs/iterations/PROVENANCE.md) recording the hash of every received file and where it landed. Files changed when the repository was seeded are listed in origin/SEED-DIFF.md, with each original kept under origin/.
